lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD $80 (419440) / 1.22 = $65.57, rounded down to $65 (all-in $79.30). lots.condition: Looks clean with good lustre, no obvious chips or peeling in photos; stringing and knotting condition unknown.
lots.question_for_armitage: Is the clasp marked 9ct/375 or 14k/585, or is it plated? Are the pearls real cultured (gritty on the teeth) or shell/glass imitation, and is the strand knotted between pearls and in sound condition?
